title: Opening hours
en: We are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 17:00 and on Saturday from 9:00 to 13:00. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.
sw: Tunafunguliwa Jumatatu hadi Ijumaa kuanzia saa 8:00 hadi 17:00, na Jumamosi kuanzia saa 9:00 hadi 13:00. Jumapili na sikukuu za umma tumefunga.

title: Booking an appointment
en: You can book an appointment at the reception desk or through the clinic booking line during opening hours. Walk-in patients are seen after patients with appointments.
sw: Unaweza kupanga miadi kwenye dawati la mapokezi au kupitia nambari ya kupanga miadi ya zahanati wakati wa saa za kazi. Wagonjwa wasio na miadi huhudumiwa baada ya wale wenye miadi.

title: What to bring
en: Please bring your national ID, your insurance or SHA card, any previous clinic cards or reports, and a list of the medicines you currently take.
sw: Tafadhali leta kitambulisho chako cha taifa, kadi yako ya bima au SHA, kadi au ripoti za awali za kliniki, na orodha ya dawa unazotumia sasa.

title: Fasting before blood tests
en: For fasting blood sugar and cholesterol tests, do not eat for 8 to 10 hours before the test. You may drink water.
sw: Kwa vipimo vya sukari na kolesteroli ya damu, usile chochote kwa saa 8 hadi 10 kabla ya kipimo. Unaweza kunywa maji.

title: Child immunisation
en: Child immunisation is offered on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 8:00 to 12:00. Please bring the child's health card.
sw: Chanjo za watoto hutolewa Jumanne na Alhamisi kuanzia saa 8:00 hadi 12:00. Tafadhali leta kadi ya afya ya mtoto.

title: Payment
en: We accept cash, M-Pesa and insurance. The M-Pesa till number is displayed at the reception desk.
sw: Tunapokea pesa taslimu, M-Pesa na bima. Nambari ya till ya M-Pesa imebandikwa kwenye dawati la mapokezi.

title: Lab results
en: Routine lab results are ready in 24 to 48 hours. Collect them at reception with your ID. We do not give results by phone or messaging.
sw: Matokeo ya kawaida ya vipimo huwa tayari baada ya saa 24 hadi 48. Yachukue mapokezi ukiwa na kitambulisho. Hatutoi matokeo kwa simu wala ujumbe.

title: Pharmacy
en: The on-site pharmacy is open during clinic hours. Medicines are dispensed only with a prescription from our clinicians.
sw: Famasia yetu iko wazi wakati wa saa za zahanati. Dawa hutolewa tu kwa agizo la daktari wetu.

title: Cancelling or rescheduling
en: Please cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours before your appointment.
sw: Tafadhali ghairi au badilisha miadi yako angalau saa 24 kabla ya wakati wake.

title: Antenatal clinic
en: The antenatal clinic runs on Wednesdays from 9:00 to 12:00.
sw: Kliniki ya wajawazito (antenatal) hufanyika Jumatano kuanzia saa 9:00 hadi 12:00.
